scope: Current 48-file source boundary; this is a planning and answer-strength constraint, not a startup blocker.

gaps.description: Project-specific turbine model, unit capacity, system boundary and equipment tag mapping are not present in the current source set.
gaps.impact: Generic or conditional evidence must not be presented as direct evidence for an unidentified nuclear unit.
gaps.required_input: Approved project equipment list, unit design basis and tag dictionary.

gaps.description: The project-approved list of applicable standards, procedures and technical agreements is not present.
gaps.impact: Registry records may identify candidate or conditional applicability but cannot assert project adoption.
gaps.required_input: Project standards register and approved procedure list.

gaps.description: Project-specific manufacturer drawings, technical agreements, deviation approvals and repair limits are not present.
gaps.impact: Physical actions, numerical adjustments and deviations require additional manufacturer or design evidence.
gaps.required_input: Approved manufacturer documentation and deviation/exception records.

gaps.description: No current field measurements, inspection records, test results or acceptance records are included.
gaps.impact: The system can state requirements and verification steps but cannot conclude current field conformity.
gaps.required_input: Traceable site data with measurement time, instrument, unit and responsible organization.
